The issuer shows solid profitability (EBIT margin ~33% and positive net income) and moderate leverage (total liabilities of ~7,758M against equity of ~7,253M). However, liquidity is weak with a current ratio below 1 (current assets 1,047M vs current liabilities 1,322M), which constrains short-term financial flexibility. Overall, this supports a lower investment-grade rating rather than a higher tier.  
DECISION: BBB+
